beats.say: Can AI read a clock? Barely.
In 2025, a test called ClockBench showed top AI models 180 analog clocks.
Humans got the time right eighty nine percent of the time. The best AI? Thirteen percent.
And when it missed, it was usually off by about an hour.

beats.sub: the problem was seeing the hands
beats.say: Weirdly, the math was fine. When it saw the time right, it nailed the calculations. It just couldn't see the hands.

beats.sub: one theory: too few in training data
beats.say: One theory: unusual clock faces are rare in its training data.

beats.sub: best AI on the leaderboard today
beats.say: Today the best model scores eighty three percent. Still worse than you.
